verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU/NPU silicon), not a service that holds user data, so exporting your data in open formats and leaving does not apply to it. AI Hub's model conversion to ONNX and LiteRT concerns developer model deployment, not exporting user data, and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
